findings.evidence: `let ρE : Representation k Gal(E/k) (U.restrictScalars k) := U'.toRepresentation.ofSurjective ...` appears at Discrete.lean:131, :177 and :269, each preceded by the same `U'`/`IsTrivial` block and followed by the same `hsemiE` proof.
findings.fix: Factor out a private construction: from an E-submodule U of V that Gal(L/k) preserves and E.fixingSubgroup fixes pointwise, build the Gal(E/k)-representation on U.restrictScalars k with an ofSurjective_apply-style lemma and its semilinearity lemma. Then call it from all three theorems, and generalize span_range_mem_and_fix to any such span.
findings.issue: The finite-level reduction (U, U', IsTrivial instance on the kernel, ρE via ofSurjective, hsemiE) is duplicated almost verbatim in liftBaseChange_injective_of_invariant_of_isGalois (l.131), range_eq_invariants_of_liftBaseChange_surjective_of_isGalois (l.177) and span_invariants_eq_top_of_isOpen (l.269). The latter also re-proves the stability and fixing properties of span_range_mem_and_fix inline (hU_mem/hU_fix), giving three proofs of 40 to 70 lines.

findings.issue: The subfield-closure argument is repeated: `Fσ` inside isContinuous_iff_exists_openSubgroup_fixes_embedding (a ~50-line proof) rebuilds an IntermediateField of elements fixed by a ring automorphism, field by field. openStabilizerSubfield (l.280) does the same for open stabilizers. The open-stabilizer Subgroup is also defined twice: privately as `stabSubgroup` in Descent.lean and as a local `let stabSubgroup` in Discrete.lean:304.

summary: Proofs compile, but the reduction to a finite Galois subextension is copy-pasted three times in Discrete.lean, the linear-disjointness/finite-basis argument twice in GaloisDescent.lean, and one ring isomorphism is hand-built from rfl fields.
